reapack.name: reaper_native_notator.lua
reapack.desc: REAPER-Notator: Native Musical Notation & Engraving Suite

metadata.description: Native musical notation, score editing, and engraving environment for Cockos REAPER. Requires ReaImGui v0.10+ and Reaticulate.

version.author: A-intheCode
version.changelog: + v2.58: New: Multi-Note Block Drag & Drop across staves with full SMuFL Ghost Notes preview (Ctrl+Drag to copy), Shortcut Copy of selected notes to adjacent displayed staff above/below (Ctrl+UpArrow / Ctrl+DownArrow), and Legal Notice update + v2.57: Hotfix: Reliable first-click Note Preview (AudioPreview) with active REAPER track MIDI & Audio status detection (Track_GetPeakInfo on MIDI channels 1024/1025 and Audio channels 0/1) and closed-loop Note-On retry

version.author: A-intheCode
version.changelog: + v2.56: Hotfix: Fix "ImGui assertion failed: font_cfg->SizePixels > 0.0f" crash on systems running ReaImGui < 0.10 (auto-detect legacy 3-argument ImGui_CreateFont / ImGui_CreateFontFromFile vs. ReaImGui 0.10+ 2-argument dynamic font API in FontManager.init), and prominently document ReaImGui v0.10+ dependency in GitHub README & ReaPack metadata + v2.55: Stable Release: Fix Display Quantize (1/1 to 1/32) visual note position & duration quantization (Engraver.quantize_notes_for_display & Engraver.get_display_quantized_qn), intra-measure barline clamping (notes at the end of a bar never jump across the barline into the next measure), grid-slot consolidation (preserving simultaneous chords and selection links), immediate measure-map cache invalidation & ProjExtState/ExtState persistence when toggling Display Quantize in Top Bar or Tools Drawer, and 100% zero impact on score rendering or MIDI when Display Quantize is disabled + v2.54: Stable Release: Settings Modal improvements (all sections collapsed by default on launch & collapsible "Donate if you want to contribute" section with Gumroad link) and updated high-resolution illustrated User Manual (PDF) + v2.53: Stable Release: Melodic Pathfinder 2.0 (8 descriptive Film Score Archetypes, Leitmotif & period phrasing up to 32 bars, automatic Key & Mode detection, half-bar chord lock, Anchor-Note blending, 3 interactive coupled Bezier curves [Tension, Note Length, Pitch] with freehand Draw -> auto-simplified Edit Handles, 4 RAM slots & JSON export/import), pre-armed target track with [REC] badge & 2-stage warmup for instant first-note audition, full Reaticulate clone bank resolution (fixing Spitfire BBC Trumpet & cloned banks), and updated illustrated User Manual
